record.title: Observe stock two-word composition immediately after the global store
record.intent: Complete one device-response to stock application-state transition without instruction stepping through synchronization.
requirements: Fresh pinned disposable guest and byte-identical stock APK and native library.
Preserve existing guarded two-read responses at offsets 0x4048 and 0x4044 with words 0xe1234567 and 0x89abcdef.
Use continuous execution to a hardware breakpoint at stock ELF 0x42a8f0 immediately after the global store.
No further device responses, instruction edits, forced synchronization returns or converter execution.
Stop on any additional observed mapped access, unexpected signal, unsupported breakpoint state or bounded timeout.
Inventory live threads and supervision state before modeled reads and at the terminal boundary; do not freeze siblings.
Keep existing guest admission fixtures narrow and enforcement enabled; no physical instrument or host policy changes.
acceptance: Private positive and unexpected-access controls validate two-response guards and precise terminal observation.
Record hardware debug setup/readback and actual trap PC/address/code with stock instruction binding.
Capture x8/x9, global GOT pointer and stored value against predicted 0x0123456789abcdef after the store.
Independently verify evidence, stock preservation, stable system_server and teardown.
State main-thread-only ordering limits and classify absent terminal delivery as a negative outcome.
